quotes.text: Here's the problem. Zero Trust without audit evidence is policy theater. Verification isn't a checkbox. It's a trail.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Frames the episode's core thesis that Zero Trust needs provable evidence, not just policies.

quotes.text: Repeated medium-risk events over days correlates strongly with later data staging, therefore escalate repetition, not just severity.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Gives a concrete, counter-intuitive triage rule for identity risk signals.

quotes.text: Disabling or weakening retention is the classic cover your tracks move. Zero trust assumes breach, but defensibility assumes immutable evidence.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Explains why Purview retention edits are a key forensic signal.

quotes.text: If it touches a file to answer a prompt, that's access. If that access isn't logged, your zero-trust narrative fractures.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: Clarifies where Copilot-related exfiltration risk actually sits and what to monitor.

quotes.text: The lesson is simple. If you can't replay the first 12 hours, you can't prove intent or sequence.
quotes.speaker: Mirko Peters
quotes.why: A memorable argument for log retention beyond default windows.

chapters.title: Entra sign-in risk: verify the verifier
Unified audit log and lateral movement

takeaways: Repeated medium-risk Entra sign-ins that pass MFA are a stronger exfiltration lead than a single high-risk spike, so escalate by count and diversity.
Data staging shows up as correlated patterns in the unified audit log, such as a new sync client plus widened sharing links and novel file reads in one session.
Purview retention edits and Copilot interaction logs must be correlated with identity and audit events, exported beyond native retention and protected by dual control.
hook: Your Zero Trust controls can say "allowed" while 12,000 files quietly leave SharePoint. This episode shows security and compliance teams how to correlate Entra sign-in risk, the unified audit log, Purview policy edits and Copilot interaction logs into one defensible timeline, with concrete KQL detection recipes, alerts and playbooks.
